executionArgs.additionalInstruction: The app uses HashRouter. Navigate with hash URLs such as http://localhost:5173/#/ and http://localhost:5173/#/queue. There is no login. Wait for the sidebar and page heading to appear before interacting. In Vite browser mode Electron APIs may be missing; do not fail solely because native downloads or folder picker are unavailable. For URL analysis use https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ.
